change_class: NEW PUBLIC SURFACE (unlisted) — a pre-trade check for one crypto perpetual futures order: GO / CAUTION / WAIT with reasons, the cheapest venue by base-tier taker fees and funding over the hold, a size limit from 24h volume, funding timing and the market regime
change_note: Served on tools/list, kept off the nav, /docs and /tools (FEATURE_REGISTRY publicListing:false) until DECISION-CALL-V1-W3 lists and prices it. The response is built by naming permitted keys (toPreTradeCheckResponse, an exported allow-list formatter), never by spreading an engine object, so a field added to the engine cannot reach the wire. The decision is pure (src/lib/pre-trade-decision.ts, PRE_TRADE_RULE_VERSION) over the shared venue-market-state reads; it never reads AlgoVault's directional call and never proposes a side — `side` is the caller's, echoed. Every refusal is unbilled; one unit per decision, a WAIT included.
source: src/tools/pre-trade-check.ts (runPreTradeCheck, toPreTradeCheckResponse) + src/lib/pre-trade-decision.ts (rankVenues, decide) + src/lib/pre-trade-costs.ts + src/lib/venue-fees.ts; pre-deploy capture
algovault_note: `exchange` and `venue_status` name the best venue and appear only when there is one; `upgrade_hint`, `tier_warning` and `quota` follow the caller's tier exactly as get_market_regime's envelope does.

error_contract.transport: MCP only: every refusal is a structured JSON text payload with isError:true. `status` is the handler's outcome status (the pipeline's http.status), kept for a future HTTP channel.

quota wall (TierLimitReachedError).note: thrown and rendered by buildTierLimitPayload exactly as get_market_regime's wall — quota-surfaces row refusal:pre_trade_check

error_contract.order: invalid_parameter → venue_not_supported → quota wall → data_unavailable → coin_not_listed; nothing before the decision is billed

forbidden_keys_note: The contract forbids a `call`, `verdict`, `reasoning`, `price_at_signal` or any `outcome_*` key, a proposed side, and an edge / return / win-rate claim: this tool prices and times an order the caller already chose; it never reads or serves AlgoVault's directional call. `descriptionRef` and `signal_hash` are internal identifiers.
consumers: MCP tools/list + tools/call (unlisted: no /docs page, no nav or /tools entry, no TOOL_LABELS row)

cache_contract.description: Nothing in the response is cached per caller. The inputs are the shared venue-market-state caches: venue universes 60 s single-flight, the merged funding snapshot 30 s per adapter; the regime is the newest fresh servable bar-close generation (regime_snapshots, read-only).
cache_contract.client_cache_refresh: an ADDED tool — an open MCP session sees pre_trade_check after it reconnects or re-fetches tools/list

drift_check_command: curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/capabilities | jq -e '.tools[] | select(.name == "pre_trade_check") | .x402 == null' >/dev/null && echo SHAPE_OK
